jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Skeletons, lasers, tattoo buses — the Torq brand grabs attention like nothing else in cybersecurity. And we're growing like crazy, backed by Series D funding, 200% employee growth, and 300% revenue growth. Fueling Torq's momentum is our game-changing AI SOC platform, backed by a team and culture that makes Torq one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in America, and a Business Insider 'startup to bet your career on'.

Life at Torq is all gas, no brakes. We're a team of relentless, collaborative go-getters pushing the boundaries of what's possible for security automation. Every role is an essential driver of Torq's success as the AI-native autonomous SecOps platform of choice for security teams across the Fortune 500.

A Product Analyst at Torq plays a key role in helping Product teams understand what’s happening, why it’s happening, and what to do next. By proactively identifying trends, asking the right questions, and connecting insights across product and user data, you’ll help shape product decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.

What You Will Do:

- Proactively identify trends, opportunities, and product questions, turning data into actionable insights and recommendations.

- Deep dive into user behavior, product performance, adoption, funnels, and usage to understand not only what is happening, but why.

- Partner with Product to define meaningful KPIs, monitor performance, and use A/B testing and other analytical methods to identify opportunities for improvement.

- Work closely with Product, R&D, and other stakeholders to translate insights into product priorities and decisions.

- Build dashboards, reports, and analytical frameworks that help teams understand product performance and make better decisions.

- Ensure accuracy and attention to detail, building trust in the data and insights used across the organization.

The Ideal Candidate:

- 3+ years of experience in Product Analytics or a similar analytical role, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with a proactive and curious mindset and the ability to connect the dots and uncover meaningful insights.

- Proficient in SQL (complex joins, window functions) and experienced with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools for analytics; experience building AI agents is a strong advantage.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence product decisions through data.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to build trust and confidence in data and insights.

- Bonus : Experience with Amplitude, Salesforce, or data modeling/ETL processes.

We build AI for a living,  and we encourage candidates to use it to prep, research, and sharpen their best work. But we're hiring humans, not chatbots. We want the real you.  Use AI to tighten your resume, prep for interviews, research Torq, and outline ideas for written responses. Show up as yourself for live interviews, final assessments (the voice, logic, and reasoning need to be yours), and anywhere we're evaluating how you think — not how you prompt.

Excited about our vision and ready to make an impact as we grow? We'd love to see what you can bring to the team.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to a team defined and empowered by diversity. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Torq will process your personal data in accordance with Torq’s Privacy Policy.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-savvy Product Manager to join Torq as we continue expanding and exploring the hottest intersection in the security market: agentic AI and SecOps. The ideal candidate will have both experience in at least one SOC-adjacent domain (threat intelligence, SecOps, hunting, incident response…) and strong understanding of agentic AI.

You’ll own parts of Torq’s agentic platform: where agents are managed, how they interact with users, and how they can help SOCs to reduce system-critical metrics and overall threat exposure.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Lead critical parts of Torq’s agentic platform to help drive forward adoption and innovation across the full lifecycle - from UX to prompt engineering

- Become an expert in Torq’s AI SOC offering and in Torq’s Platform as a whole

- Represent the customer’s voice inside Torq to ensure we’re staying on the critical path

- Work closely with Torq’s top-notch engineering teams to deliver product capabilities and stay on top of state-of-the-art AI trends

- Analyze product data - from classic product analytics to AI evaluations of usage patterns - to proactively bubble up user needs or issues

The Ideal Candidate

- Has 3-5 years of product management experience

- Possesses a strong understanding of agentic / LLM products - from UX to the technical LLM engineering stack

- Spent at least 2 years working in the cybersecurity market, ideally in a SOC-adjacent space (SecOps, incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting)

- Extensively worked with automation products and APIs - can look under the hood and understand systems and architecture

- Data-driven, with the ability to ask the right questions

jobs.description:

Life at Torq is all gas, no brakes. We're a team of relentless, collaborative go-getters pushing the boundaries of what's possible for security automation. Every role is an essential driver of Torq's success as the AI-native autonomous SecOps platform of choice for security teams across the Fortune 500.

We are looking for an experienced  Senior Product Manager to own Torq's Builder Experience domain - a core part of how security teams design, build, and deploy automations. As AI fundamentally changes how security operations work, this role sits at the center of that shift.

This role requires genuine product craft - the ability to see what security teams actually struggle with and shape tools that feel intuitive and powerful - alongside frontier AI product thinking: defining how a conversational AI should behave, where its limits are, how it earns trust, and how it sharpens with every interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Own the end-to-end builder experience - from understanding where security teams get stuck to shipping flows that feel intuitive and powerful

- Care about how the product looks and feels. Partner closely with Design to turn ambiguity into clear, usable flows

- Drive our conversational AI product forward as a first-class part of the platform

- Own how we evaluate the AI experience: define what "good" means, how we measure quality, and how we improve it continuously

- Perform customer research and hands-on deep-dives to understand how people build and where they get stuck

- Analyze usage patterns and feedback to spot signal and translate it into actionable engineering requirements

- Make critical decisions on trade-offs across experience, capability, and technical design to meet business objectives

- Work closely with engineering to define, develop, and launch new capabilities

Our company and team spirit foster an environment that encourages taking initiative, being open to new ideas, and enjoying the ride!

The Ideal Candidate

- 3-5 years of experience as a product manager on SaaS products, OR 2+ years in PM following an engineering role

- Strong product sense for UX and UI. You understand user pain and can shape an experience that fits it

- Genuine interest in AI products. You're curious about how they behave, how they fail, and how they earn user trust

- Enough technical fluency to work closely with engineering and reason about how the product is built and consumed

- Data-driven, with the ability to ask the right questions

- Excellent interpersonal skills, able to drive teams and interfaces without direct authority

- Strong communication. You can move between a customer conversation, a design review, and an engineering spec without dropping the thread

- Computer Science degree or equivalent technical background

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI/LLM products or agent-based interfaces

- Experience evaluating and improving product quality with metrics and experimentation

- Background in security, DevOps, or automation platforms

- Experience partnering tightly with Design on visual, interaction-rich products
